title: SEC4: receipt branch in outbox_tick needs control-flow comment
description: Lines 932-973 in crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs: The receipt handling block is separated with a comment but doesn't explain the design: why the early `continue` completely diverges from the message-delivery path below. A new reader might ask: 'Why not unify these code paths?' A clarifying comment should state the reason: 'Receipt entries require no message payload or chat lookup—full separation is simpler than conditional branching.'
